_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored; keep it that way.

_notes.polymarket_private_key: Wallet key used for signing. Treat as irrecoverable if leaked — anyone holding it controls the funds in that wallet. Prefer a dedicated wallet holding only what you intend to trade.
_notes.kalshi_password: Account credentials, not an API token. If Kalshi offers scoped API keys, prefer those over storing the login.
_notes.dry_run: See issue #5 — verify which mode the advisor runs in before supplying real credentials.
